_comment: Master Storyteller tale pool — broadcasted line-by-line every 30s.

stories.title: Lord British and the Black Stone
lines: "Long before the Fellowship rose," the bard begins, "Lord British discovered a black stone deep in Dungeon Despise."
"Whoever touched it was struck with a vision — the future of Britannia, or its ruin."
"He sealed the stone in a vault below the castle, and forbade any to speak of it."
"Yet on some nights, when the moons align, the vault doors are found open…"
"…and the stone is missing."

stories.title: The Last Voyage of Captain Stenmark
lines: "They say Captain Stenmark sailed past the Lost Lands chasing rumors of a treasure island."
"His ship was found three weeks later, intact and drifting — but every soul aboard was gone."
"The hold was packed with gold and silver. The maps showed an island that no chart records."
"His logbook contained a single final entry: 'They are below the keel.'"
"To this day, no captain will sail those waters at night."

stories.title: The Reapers of Yew
lines: "In the deep forest of Yew, the trees themselves can move."
"A logger named Tomek swore he saw one walk — a reaper, bent and ancient."
"It plucked a deer from the brush as easily as you would pluck a flower."
"He fled, of course. They always do."
"But the trees remember. Even now, when you fell one in Yew, the others lean closer to listen."

stories.title: Mondain's Final Apprentice
lines: "Mondain had three known apprentices — and one whose name the Council struck from every record."
"This fourth was no mage. She was a child the sorcerer raised from the moment of her first scream."
"When the great wizard fell, the apprentices scattered. But she… she went looking."
"For what? For HIM. And the rumour is — she still walks the lands."
"Listen close at the next moongate. If you hear a girl singing, do not turn around."
